name: Graphcore Bow-2000 IPU-Machine Datasheet
notes: Official Graphcore technical specifications datasheet for Bow-2000 IPU-Machine containing 4 Bow IPU processors. Details 1.394 PFLOPS FP16 AI compute (348.5 TFLOPS per Bow IPU), 0.349 PFLOPS FP32 compute (87.25 TFLOPS per Bow IPU), 3.6 GB In-Processor Memory (900 MB per Bow IPU), 261 TB/s memory bandwidth, and 1700W max system power cap.
